lead.headline: Achane is out for the season, and AVIATO is 0-3
lead.deck: A torn ACL, confirmed Monday. Claim Ollie Gordon II before Wednesday 01:00 and drop Achane.
lead.body: De'Von Achane tore his ACL on a first-quarter run at Miami and will miss the rest of the season (ESPN; NFL.com, Monday). Chem has no IR slot, so he is a roster spot that cannot score. Ollie Gordon II played 84% of Miami's snaps after the injury; the claim for him, with Achane as the drop, processes at 01:00 Wednesday Mexico City. The risk is Jaylen Wright, whom Miami called day-to-day on Monday. Justin Jefferson's ankle is a sprain and Jalen Coker's quad strain is minor. Footballers finished on 140.6 against AVIATO's 103.8. The lineup was the projection lineup; three starters got hurt.

What would change it: Wright returns and Gordon draws under 12 touches in Week 4.
